prior.title: Help cue repeated identically and too long
prior.expected: A cue that changes and moves a 9-year-old on, in a few words.
prior.got: Help pressed three times gave the same 'Try: I like to build. My favourite block is...'
evidence: #2-#4 identical 'Try: I like to build. My favourite block is...'; #5 had to use quiz.

prior.title: Held-fix explanations misleading
prior.expected: Accurate child wording that fits the question asked.
prior.got: 'because you mean more than one dog' after 'Do you like dogs?'; 'One friend, like Rex' for a dog.
evidence: #19 recap held fixes for 'I like dog' and 'Rex like football'.

prior.got: 20 entries incl. booking, lost jacket, group project, speaking practice.
evidence: #1 and #19 list with 'A booking that is missing', 'Our group project'.

prior.title: Simplified help repeats the previous question
prior.expected: Simpler rewording of the current question.

criteria.evidence: No placement in this journey; level fixed to A1 by hand.
#5 choice task 'I like to build a big house.' / 'I build big house like.' is under 15 words.
#7 'You wanted to say Nevím... In English: I don't know' is neutral; #8 'Good!' follows. No failure line.
#1 list has 20 entries incl. 'A booking that is missing', 'Our group project', 'The lost jacket', 'Speaking practice: about you'; not all suit a 9-year-old.

#8 'Good! Do you know where creepers live?' is a yes/no with an off-level concept; #2 'Hi friend! What are you making today?' ok, but #3 simplified 'What are you making?' and Sam asks two questions in a row (#8 transcript: 'Creepers are funny! What are you making?' then 'Good! Do you know...').

#15 held fix 'I like dog' → 'I like dogs... when you talk about dogs in general' is fine, but 'Dům... house' → 'house' with 'A building where people live' is a redundant explanation; and the moment 'Good!' after Nevím and Sam's unanswered question mismatch. Also #5/#10 help shows 'Sam asks: What do you like to build?' unrelated to actual question.

done.evidence: #2 'Help me answer' and #5 'Choose a phrase' found on the scene without leaving the conversation.

Help did not unblock: #11 reply 'Creeper... Minecraft. I like dog. Nevím.' still has Nevím after the phrase 'I like to build a big house'; #5/#10 phrase asks 'What do you like to build?' not the current question; no coaching note quoting the learner (coaching null).
#8 replay shown as a fresh question but #15 'Tried again: Creeper... Minecraft. I like dog. Nevím.' — replay.used false and answer still contains Nevím, not better.
#15 '2 on your own · 2 with help'; evidence marks supported:true for the helped replies.

judge.voice: Jo, Minecraft! I liked talking to Sam, and the "I don't know" bit was fun — I said Nevím and it told me how to say it in English, no shouting. But the help was strange. I pressed the phrase button and it asked a different question about building a house. Sam asked about creepers living somewhere and I didn't understand, and the "simpler" words were the same words. So I just said creeper, dog, Minecraft again. When I tried again, I still said Nevím. Mum would also see the long list of things like bookings and group projects — that's school, nuda. I'd use it for the creeper talk, but the help needs to really help. I wouldn't trust it to teach me yet.
